title: Disagreeing Politely
goal: Combine a granted point, doubt and no es que… sino que… to disagree politely.

items: I can disagree politely by granting a point and then stating my doubt.
I can soften a disagreement with no diría que and the subjunctive.
I can use the new words for debating an idea.
